caption: Ordinary text renders as is, emoji included (unlike Zulip, no :shortcodes:); each item adds one inline style. As GitHub: ~~strikethrough~~ and backslash escapes, but one tilde is text. MSG_ links a message.
md:
Most ordinary text just gets rendered as is: punctuation (3 < 4 & "quotes"), letters of any script (naïve, 日本語), and emoji 🎉 👍 🇺🇸, untouched. There are no :smile: shortcodes.

- **bold** and __bold__
- *italic* and _italic_
- ***both***
- `code`, and `` a ` in code ``
- [a link](https://example.com) (a new tab) and [a local one](/help)
- bare: https://example.com, www.example.com, me@example.com
- a message: MSG_plans_3
- not markup: snake_case_name, a * lone star, 2 * 3
- ~~struck~~, ~5 minutes, and \*escaped\* stars

caption: Fences, nested: a fence's text is kept exactly, a language names its class, a longer fence holds a shorter one, and the chat's quote fence holds a whole message, fences and all.
md:
A fence keeps its text exactly, markup and all:

```zig
const s = "**not bold**";
```

~~~
tildes fence too, here with no language
~~~

A longer fence holds a shorter one, which stays text:

````markdown
```zig
const x = 1;
```
````

The chat's quote fence shows a message as written, its own fences included:

````quote
Here is my fix:
```zig
const y = 2;
```
````
